text: After chopping first tree: inventory Wood 5 but objective panel still 'Wood 0/10'. Also 'Ate an apple (+15 energy)' status appeared though I didn't press eat; Apples still shows 1. Tip already advanced to 'Gather stone' while objective is still wood.

Objective 2 'Eat something' completed on its own ~immediately after objective 1; I never saw it as the active objective nor pressed eat. Tips are still on 'Gather stone' (tip 3 of 5) while the objective is now 'Create or join a nation' - tips and objectives are out of sync.

Pressing N instantly created a nation with a random name ('Farmshire') - no prompt to name it, no confirmation. As a new player I expected to choose the name. Chronicle lines are truncated with '...' (e.g. 'with Yvonne...').

Objective bar reads 'Wood 47/50' while inventory says Wood 52 and Found Settlement button is already enabled. Objective progress consistently lags inventory by several seconds (also 0/10 vs 5 earlier, 36/50 vs 41). Tip 'Gather stone' has been stuck for the entire session since objectives never ask for stone.

Founding took 3 tries: the 'too close' message gives directions (north-west / north) but the only orientation aid on screen is the 'Facing:' text - no compass or map - so following 'about 10 paces to the north-west' is guesswork. Once founded, the settlement's floating name label is hidden behind the status toast and my character is inside the well model (not visible).

Settlement screen: 'Residents: 1 of 8 (0 here now). You are inside it.' contradicts itself. The 'Give to: you / Give' control dominates the screen with no context for a brand-new player (why would I give away my first camp?). World label '0 here, 1/8 residents' bleeds through behind the title. No hint of what to do next here (next building needs 25 wood + 10 stone, but nothing points me to K).

Objective 5 'Enter your settlement' did NOT complete after I pressed E, got the CAMP OF FARMSHIRE screen ('Entered settlement.' status, tick 4540), and exited via 'Exit Settlement'. 300 ticks later the objective panel still says 'Enter your settlement'.

Building the stall was confusing: objective says 'press B inside your settlement'. Pressing E opens the CAMP OF FARMSHIRE panel, but B does nothing there (pressed twice, no message). Only after clicking 'Back' (not 'Exit Settlement') does the in-settlement HUD appear with Build Stall etc., and B works. 'Back' vs 'Exit Settlement' meaning is unclear. In this HUD the Tip 5 popup overlaps the Inventory panel, and the screen is crowded with 13 buttons.

Objective 7 progress bar label is clipped on the left: reads 'mbers 2/10 • Buildings 0/2' (Members cut off). Also still 'Buildings 0/2' right after 'Farm built.' (lag). Goal needs 10 members but the camp only holds 8 residents (Residents 2/8) - unclear how a player reaches 10. 'Send Caravan (Village era)' button looks enabled though era-locked. Inventory panel floats mid-screen in the settlement HUD.

Standing next to my member Eve Wood inside my settlement, pressing E (the 'talk' key) exited the settlement instead of talking to her. Once outside, the button says 'Talk to Eve Wood (Stranger)' although R said 'Eve Wood is already a member of Farmshire' - a member labelled Stranger is confusing.

Pause menu is clear and shows 'Autosaved: Day 1 - Farmshire, 15:20.' (nice). But the settlement's giant floating label '1 here, 2/8 residents' is drawn huge across the top of every screen while near home, even behind PAUSED, and was never readable as a name.
